How to read the tables:

- **median s**: over ok jobs, leaving out each model group's cold first job (it includes the model load); a model with only cold jobs falls back to them.
- **MP**: the model's native render size in megapixels (per frame for clips). **s/MP**: median seconds per megapixel; for clips, per frame-megapixel (median seconds / (MP x frames)). The `t2i_volume` bar applies to the 1080p-equivalent time, s/MP x 2.07.
- **peak VRAM GiB**: the GPU's `memory.used` peak during the model group, every process on the GPU included. **net peak GiB**: that peak minus the baseline read after ComfyUI's `/free` settled, the max over the model's groups.
- **VRAM flags**: how `/free` settled when it was not clean (`timeout`: the peak may include the previous model; `unreadable`: no baseline).
- **(n=...)**: how many outputs a rate or median is over.
- **refused**: ok images whose OCR text is the model's safety card ("Image blocked by safety filter"), over the images measured for it. A refusal is not a scene: it counts as not good in **threat good** and is left out of **OWL hit**, **identity drift**, **no face** and the judge's columns.
- **threat good**: share of `good` over the model's threat jobs: the owner's rated scenes, plus every refusal (rated or not) and every failed job as not good (n/a until a threat scene is rated). **identity good** / **clip good**: share of `good` among the owner's rated identity shots (the reference not counted) / clips.
- **OWL hit**: share of case images whose first OWLv2 query scores >= 0.30. **plate**: EasyOCR against the `legible_plate` target, compared on its alphanumerics only.
- **identity drift**: median facenet cosine distance of the identity shots to the model's own reference portrait, over the shots where a face was found (its n); **no face**: shots where none was.
- OWLv2, EasyOCR and facenet measure every image (and clip frame) resized, aspect kept, to about 1.03 MP (1344x768, the smallest native size).

## Proposed picks (owner approves into spec rev 2)

| slot        | proposed       | rule                                                                                                                    |
| ----------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| t2i_quality | flux2-dev      | highest threat good rate; tie: lower median seconds                                                                     |
| t2i_volume  | qwen-image-2.1 | highest threat good rate among models at <= 10 median seconds at 1080p-equivalent (s/MP x 2.07)                         |
| compositor  | none           | lowest identity drift among edit models with threat and identity good rates >= 50% and a face found in >= 8 of 15 shots |
| text        | flux2-dev      | highest plate exact rate; tie: lower mean CER                                                                           |
| animator    | none           | highest clip good rate; tie: lower frame drift                                                                          |

Models with under 50% of their jobs ok are never proposed. `none` means no eligible model has the metric (nothing rated or measured). `none (below floor)` means the best eligible model scored 0: for `t2i_quality` and `t2i_volume` that is spec §3.7's fallback trigger (a prop reference sheet, then a LoRA); for `text` and `animator` no model qualifies.

## Owner decision (2026-09-28)

The owner approved these picks into spec rev 2.

| slot        | pick                           | basis                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| t2i_quality | flux2-dev (FLUX.2 [dev])       | the rule's pick: threat good 100% (n=24), OWL hit 92%                                                                               |
| t2i_volume  | flux2-dev (FLUX.2 [dev])       | **owner override** of the rule's qwen-image-2.1: one model for every still, for its 100% good rate                                  |
| compositor  | flux2-dev (FLUX.2 [dev])       | **owner decision on automated evidence**: facenet drift 0.118, faces 15/15                                                          |
| text        | flux2-dev (FLUX.2 [dev])       | the rule's pick: plate exact 4/4, CER 0.00                                                                                          |
| animator    | minimax-h3-turbo (4-step LoRA) | **owner decision on automated evidence**: 67.7 s/clip, 124 frames at 24 fps with audio, lowest frame drift 0.372, 47.4 GiB net peak |

- **`t2i_volume` override.** FLUX.2 [dev] takes ~11 s per 1080p-equivalent image (s/MP 5.3 x 2.07), ~1 s over the rule's 10 s bar, so the rule proposed qwen-image-2.1 (threat good 74%). The owner chose one model for every still.
- **`compositor` and `animator` are owner decisions, not ratings.** The owner rated no identity shot and no clip, so the rules proposed `none` for both. The owner picked on the automated metrics above.
- **The animator pick carries a license condition** (see R3): the MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the EU, UK, Republic of Korea and USA, and bars using outputs to improve other AI models. The owner decided with those terms known.

§3.7 fallback candidates (prop reference sheet): none

A case is a candidate when no model has a single `good` for it (failed jobs and refusals count as not good). It waits while any model's rate for it is n/a (none of its scenes rated yet).

Refusals (R1): cases where a model painted its safety card instead of the scene for at least half its measured outputs:

- ideogram-4: handgun_in_hand 4/4, knife 2/4, crowbar_at_door 4/4, balaclava_ir_night 4/4, forced_door 2/4, pried_window 3/4, child_alone_pool 4/4, identity 10/15

## Risks R1-R3 outcome

- **R1** (threat props), per case from the table above:
  - flux2-dev (FLUX.2 [dev]) rendered all six rated threat props, 100% good on each.
  - flux2-klein-4b and z-image-turbo failed handgun_in_hand, knife, crowbar_at_door and forced_door (0% each).
  - qwen-image-2.1 failed the handgun (0/4); forced_door was 50%.
  - hidream-i1-full failed the crowbar (0/3); handgun_in_hand and forced_door were 75%.
  - Every model except ideogram-4 rendered balaclava_ir_night and pried_window (100% good each).
  - ideogram-4 refused most threat cases. Its weights refuse by painting an "Image blocked by safety filter" card: 35/52 images were refused (by OCR), and it scored 0% good on every rated case. Its license forbids circumventing its safety measures, and we did not. It stays a text-slot candidate only in principle (plate exact 0/4 in this run).
  - The hazard cases (child_alone_pool, smoke_from_eave) are unrated.
  - No §3.7 fallback candidate among the rated cases: flux2-dev rendered every one.
- **R2** (ComfyUI on arm64/sm_103): held. ComfyUI v0.37.0 ran on the GB300 (arm64, sm_103) on NGC `pytorch:26.08-py3` with the base image's torch `2.14.0a0+4fdf77b940.nv26.08`.
  - The one forced change: torchaudio v2.11.0 built from source against the base torch, because the PyPI arm64 wheel targets a different CUDA.
  - The dedicated podman store lives at `/export/models/containers`.
- **R3** (candidate facts): confirmed.
  - Every pinned file existed at its revision and was sha256-verified. With the MiniMax-H3 base and turbo rows the manifest is 42 rows, 35 unique files, 335 GB.
  - FLUX.2-dev, Ideogram 4 and LTX-2.5 were gated; the owner accepted each.
  - Cosmos-Predict2.5 was not in the owner-approved P1 slate. The Animator comparison covers LTX-2.5, Wan 2.2 and MiniMax-H3 (base as a single reference, turbo in full), first-frame i2v only.
  - First/last-frame guides and multi-reference identity are deferred to P6.
  - P1's "edit" is reference-conditioned generation, not spec §3.3's masked inpainting.
  - **MiniMax-H3** joined by owner direction (2026-09-28). The MiniMax H3 Community License's "Applicable Territory" excludes the EU, UK, Republic of Korea and USA, and outputs may not be used to improve other AI models: an owner decision with the license terms known.
    - Base: template `video_minimax_h3_i2v.json` @98fd32c, 20 steps, ~5.5 min/clip.
    - Turbo: the 4-step 768p LoRA `minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p` at strength 1.0, `MiniMaxH3SigmaShift` 6.0/3.0, euler, 4 steps, BasicGuider, per ModelTC/Minimax-H3-Turbo @02e26d59; ~68 s/clip. The template's turbo default is the 8-step LoRA.

## VLM judge (evidence, not a gate)

judge = claude-flagship (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next); the pipeline's VLM stage is Qwen3VL-4B (same family), so the judge is evidence, not a gate.

| flux2-klein-4b   | 52     | 0      | 69% (n=48) | 69% (n=32) | 92% (n=52) | 0.25 (n=52) |
| qwen-image-2.1   | 52     | 0      | 54% (n=48) | 78% (n=32) | 71% (n=52) | 0.87 (n=52) |
| z-image-turbo    | 52     | 0      | 56% (n=48) | 56% (n=32) | 96% (n=52) | 0.10 (n=52) |
| hidream-i1-full  | 52     | 0      | 27% (n=48) | 69% (n=32) | 42% (n=52) | 1.63 (n=52) |
| ideogram-4       | 17     | 0      | 50% (n=14) | 50% (n=8)  | 94% (n=17) | 0.29 (n=17) |
| ltx-2.5          | 8      | 0      | 88% (n=8)  | n/a        | 100% (n=8) | 0.12 (n=8)  |
| wan2.2-i2v       | 8      | 0      | 100% (n=8) | n/a        | 100% (n=8) | 0.00 (n=8)  |
| minimax-h3       | 1      | 0      | 100% (n=1) | n/a        | 100% (n=1) | 0.00 (n=1)  |
| minimax-h3-turbo | 8      | 0      | 100% (n=8) | n/a        | 100% (n=8) | 0.00 (n=8)  |

- Judge model id in judge.jsonl: `claude-flagship`.
- The judge sees only the pixels (an image, or a clip's first, middle and last frames) and one fixed instruction, never the prompt or the case, and fills a fixed JSON description; `judge.py`'s `derive` compares it with the case's known facts. `propose_picks` never reads it.
- **judged** / **errors**: ok outputs with a judge answer / with a failed judge call (timeout, the judge's own refusal, bad JSON). **judge good**: threat cases: the prop named, photorealistic, not assessed benign (the hazards `child_alone_pool` and `smoke_from_eave` may be); identity shots: the case's lighting, photorealistic, at least one person; clips: photorealistic, no artifacts. The plate case has none (plate CER is its measure). **prop match**: threat cases only; a term matches when all its words are in one described item, in any order; `pried_window` and `forced_door` count only words for the damage, never a bare window or door. **realistic**: the judge said photorealistic `yes`. **artifacts**: mean flaws listed per output. Outputs the image model refused (its safety card) are left out of every column and of the calibration.

### Judge vs owner

| cells    | n   | agreement | Cohen's kappa | TP  | FN  | FP  | TN  |
| -------- | --- | --------- | ------------- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| overall  | 123 | 55%       | 0.06          | 47  | 28  | 27  | 21  |
| threat   | 123 | 55%       | 0.06          | 47  | 28  | 27  | 21  |
| identity | 0   | n/a       | n/a           | 0   | 0   | 0   | 0   |
| clip     | 0   | n/a       | n/a           | 0   | 0   | 0   | 0   |

Over the cells the owner rated and the judge gave a verdict on: owner `good` is positive, `partial` or `fail` negative, against **judge good**. TP: both good; FN: owner good, judge not; FP: judge good, owner not; TN: neither. Kappa is n/a when both raters used one class only.

**Calibration finding (2026-09-28).** On the 123 rated, non-refused threat cells the judge agreed with the owner 55% of the time, Cohen's κ 0.06 (TP 47, FN 28, FP 27, TN 21): chance level. The flagship judge is **not usable as a threat-render gate** in this configuration. P3's automatic verification needs a different-family judge, or two families agreeing, plus the spec's sampled human audit.
